evidence.observation: Sharp rise from ~69 to ~83 °C at k=18-19, then plateau — vapor front reaching upper column/takeoff stage
Smooth monotonic heat-up, now plateauing near 102-108 °C at k=19-20
Reflux and distillate flows steady with ratio ~3.6-4.9, small step up at k=19

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition measurement (GC/analysis) to judge separation; T701 reads ~432 °C which is implausibly high for a reboiler in this service and may indicate a thermocouple scaling/drift issue.
